mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and irbesartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker with potential teratogenic effects; concurrent use increases risk of fetal abnormalities, and isotretinoin may increase intracranial pressure while irbesartan affects fluid/electrolyte balance.
action: Avoid concurrent use in females of childbearing potential; if unavoidable, ensure robust contraception and close monitoring for increased intracranial pressure and blood pressure changes.
